response.overview: When fading Broadway star Ava takes on a comeback role in a high-profile Christmas musical, she welcomes a devoted young fan into her orbit—only to discover too late that the aspiring understudy has orchestrated a terrifying plan to replace her. As Ava is held captive beneath the theater while her rival steals her role, her voice, and her life, she must fight to reclaim her identity before the world forgets she ever existed.
response.title: 'Twas the Night Before Murder
